description: For any types A and B, their cardinalities, lifted to a common universe, are equal if and only if an equivalence A ≃ B exists.
signature:
Cardinal.lift_mk_eq'.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} :
  Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk α) = Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk β) ↔ Nonempty (α ≃ β)
